name: hash.crc32
doc:
hash.crc32: CRC-32 with the IEEE, Castagnoli or Koopman polynomial
(Go's hash/crc32). ChecksumIEEE matches crypto.hash.Crc32.

items.name: IEEE
items.doc: IEEE is the most common CRC-32 polynomial (zip, gzip, PNG).
items.summary: IEEE is the most common CRC-32 polynomial (zip, gzip, PNG).

items.name: Checksum
items.doc: Checksum returns the CRC-32 of data with tab.
items.summary: Checksum returns the CRC-32 of data with tab.

items.name: MakeTable
items.doc: The table of reversed polynomial poly (crc32.IEEE, Castagnoli, Koopman).
items.summary: The table of reversed polynomial poly (crc32.IEEE, Castagnoli, Koopman).

items.name: New
items.doc: New returns a streaming CRC-32 with tab.
items.summary: New returns a streaming CRC-32 with tab.

items.name: Update
items.signature: func Update(crc uint32, tab Table, p []byte) uint32
items.doc: Update returns crc updated with the bytes of p.
items.summary: Update returns crc updated with the bytes of p.

members.name: Write
members.doc: Write adds p to the checksum; it never fails.
members.summary: Write adds p to the checksum; it never fails.

members.name: WriteString
members.doc: WriteString adds the bytes of s to the checksum.
members.summary: WriteString adds the bytes of s to the checksum.

members.name: Sum
members.doc: Sum returns the checksum as 4 big-endian bytes.
members.summary: Sum returns the checksum as 4 big-endian bytes.

items.name: Table
items.doc: Table is a precomputed CRC-32 table (MakeTable).
items.summary: Table is a precomputed CRC-32 table (MakeTable).
